This note demonstrates the Quarto → Hugo pipeline. It is a `draft` so it will
not publish until `draft: false`. Delete this file once real `.qmd` content
exists.

## Authoring features

::: {.callout-note}
Callouts, cross-references, and citations come from Quarto and render as raw
HTML — which is why `markup.goldmark.renderer.unsafe = true` is set in
`config.toml`.
:::

Inline and display math via KaTeX:

$$
\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}
$$

## Executable code

The chunk below runs at `quarto render` time; its output is baked into the
generated `.md` that Hugo consumes.

```{python}
#| label: demo
import sys
print(f"Rendered with Python {sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}")
```
